decisions.reason: The same source message already has a MODIFY translating the Hero V right-arm gesture into the lowercase closing v.
The same source message already captures the required confidence through the Hero V right arm's final stretch; the accent derivation adds no further Hero V state change.
The existing same-message MODIFY already captures both the final-stretch refinement and joint evaluation across the Hero V, second V, and É accent.
Translating the Hero V gesture into the É accent does not change the deferred architectural construction requirements for the E and L letterforms.
The source changes the second V's gesture derivation, not its smaller and subordinate visual prominence relative to the Hero V.
The source concerns glyph geometry and gesture consistency and does not alter the deferred champagne material treatment.
The shared right-arm gesture does not necessarily change the deferred kerning requirement or its unified-reading goal.
The source provides design feedback but does not change the requirement to include rationale with review rounds.
The glyph-derivation decision is unrelated to acceptable proof attachment formats.
